name: Summer Engine
long_description: Summer is where people and agents make, play and sell games. It's like Roblox and Unreal Engine, but made to let agents handle the busy work so you can focus on all the fun.

Founder at Summer Engine. Building a place for people and agents to make and play games. 

I love art, games, and playing basketball. Fun fact, I once did 6 months full time as a painter and screenwriter. Realized I was a pretty shitty writer, and decided to help other creatives instead. Now I make it easier for people and agents to make games. Fun!

launches.title: Summer Engine - Make and play games together by chatting with AI
launches.tagline: The AI game engine. 60,000+ users, revenue up 40% in 30 days, fully organic.
launches.body:
Hey everyone, we're Mathias and Marcus, co-founders of Summer Engine.

### TL;DR

You ask for the game you want, Summer builds it, and you play it with your friends.

<https://youtu.be/-OZi9jFkZ6Y>

### The problem

Last Christmas we wanted to make a game with AI. But the tools didn't work. You could make a fancy looking prototype. But creating real multiplayer, analytics, monetization and publishing took a lot of time. Like a lot a lot.

### What Summer does

* You ask for the game you want, and Summer builds it.
* You launch it in one click and play it with your friends.
* You own your game. You can sell it and publish it on Steam, iOS, Android, Web, and on Summer Games.
* It works directly in Summer Engine or with Claude Code, Codex and Cursor.
* And you get one of the largest free asset libraries in the world, with 240,000+ assets made by the community.

### It is already working

* 60,000+ users, fully organic.
* Revenue is up 40% in the last 30 days.

### Why us

Mathias started his first company at 19 and made an exit. Marcus was an AI researcher and multiple times global rank 1 in World of Warcraft. We are gamers who rebuilt a game engine for agents.

### Our ask

Give Summer a try at [summerengine.com](https://summerengine.com), and tell us what you think. And we’d love to connect if you’re excited about games. [founders@summerengine.com](mailto:founders@summerengine.com)

PS. Garry Tan made a game in Summer in one weekend where you have to make a startup and go through YC. You can play it at [summerengine.com/games/founderstar](https://summerengine.com/games/founderstar)
